newsitem.title: USA: Interactive Flight to trade on Nasdaq NMS.
newsitem.headline: Interactive Flight to trade on Nasdaq NMS.

text.p: Interactive Flight Technologies Inc on Friday said it will begin trading on the Nasdaq national market system (NMS) under the symbol FLYT, effective Monday, May 19.

"The acceptance of IFT to Nasdaq's national market system is an important step in the future growth of our company," Michael Itkis, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "We believe the move will be instrumental in generating the amount of exposure and interest our story deserves."
Interactive Flight provides computerized gambling, movies on demand, video games and interactive shopping, on airlines.
The stock now trades on basic Nasdaq.
